name: Soul of the Ranger
body:
Associated Skills: Handle Animal, Knowledge (nature), Ride, Survival

Associated Veils: Cape of the Wanderer, Cloak of Thorns, Eyes of the Hawkguard, Gorget of the Stormking, Greaves of Skirmishing, Lightdash Bindings, Sentinel’s Helm, Verdant Vambraces

Favored Enemy (Ex)

At 1st level, the soul of the ranger imbues you with the knowledge and skills required to take down specific types of foes. When you forge this soul, select a single creature type. You gain a +2 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creatures of your selected type. You also receive a +2 bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls against them, and may make Knowledge skill checks untrained when attempting to identify them.

At 5th level and every six levels thereafter, the bonus against the selected type of creatures increases by +1.

If you choose humanoids or outsiders as your favored enemy, you must also choose an associated subtype, as described in the ranger’s favored enemy ability.

Favored Terrain (Ex)

At 3rd level, you may select a type of favored terrain each time you forge this soul, as the ranger’s favored terrain ability. You gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks when in this terrain. While traveling through your favored terrain you leave no trail and cannot be tracked (though you may leave a trail if you choose to).

At 7th level, and every six levels thereafter, the bonuses granted while in your favored terrain increase by +1.
